products.title: Country Sourdough Loaf
products.description: Our signature naturally leavened loaf with an open, tangy crumb and a dark crackling crust. Cold-fermented for 24 hours for deep flavour and easy digestibility. Baked fresh every morning.

products.title: Dark Rye Sourdough
products.description: A dense, moist Scandinavian-style rye built on a 30-year-old rye starter. Keeps for a week and pairs perfectly with cheese, cured meats and smoked fish.

products.title: Walnut & Raisin Sourdough
products.description: Sweet-savoury sourdough loaded with toasted walnuts and plump raisins. A bakery bestseller, ideal for a cheese board or simply toasted with butter.

products.title: Wholemeal Seeded Loaf
products.description: Hearty wholemeal tin loaf soaked with sunflower, pumpkin and linseed for extra crunch and nutrition. Soft crumb, sturdy crust — a perfect everyday sandwich bread.

products.title: Rustic Ciabatta
products.description: High-hydration Italian flatbread with a crisp golden crust and a beautifully irregular, airy crumb. Finished with a drizzle of cold-pressed olive oil.

products.title: French Baguette
products.description: Classic baguette baked on stone with steam for a thin, shattering crust and a soft, wheaty interior. Best enjoyed on the day of baking.

products.title: Classic Butter Croissant
products.description: Laminated with 27 layers of French AOP butter and proofed overnight for a honeycomb interior. Crisp, flaky and deeply buttery.

products.title: Pain au Chocolat
products.description: The same slow-proofed laminated dough as our croissant, wrapped around two batons of 60% dark chocolate that melt into the flaky layers.

products.title: Almond Croissant
products.description: Yesterday's croissant soaked in orange syrup, filled with frangipane and showered with flaked almonds. Baked twice for a caramelised, crunchy finish.

products.title: Cinnamon Knot
products.description: Hand-knotted brioche-style pastry swirled with cinnamon sugar, baked until golden and brushed with vanilla glaze while still warm.

products.title: Victoria Sponge (Made to Order)
products.description: Made-to-order celebration sponge, 8 inch / 12 servings, filled with raspberry jam and vanilla buttercream. Please order at least 48 hours in advance.

products.title: Celebration Sponge Cake (Made to Order)
products.description: Two-tier personalised sponge cake (20 servings) with your choice of sponge flavour, buttercream colour and hand-piped message. 5 days notice required.

products.title: Wedding Tiered Cake (Made to Order)
products.description: Three-tier wedding cake (60 servings) finished with fresh or sugar flowers. Includes a private tasting session. Minimum 6 weeks notice required.

products.title: Gluten-Free Seeded Loaf
products.description: Certified gluten-free loaf baked on dedicated gluten-free lines. Soft crumb enriched with a three-seed mix — proof that GF bread can still taste like bread.

products.title: Gluten-Free Chocolate Brownie
products.description: Dense, fudgy brownie made with 70% dark chocolate and rice flour. Naturally gluten-free, with a crackled top and a molten centre.
